Our Story

From a Local Idea to Your Neighborhood Partner

Kirihat was born from a simple observation: people in our community needed fresh groceries delivered quickly, reliably, and at fair prices. We saw an opportunity to connect local sellers, vendors, and customers in a way that benefits everyone.

Starting in Dhubri, Assam, we're building more than just a delivery platform. We're creating a ecosystem that empowers local businesses, provides flexible earning opportunities for riders, and gives customers the convenience they deserve.

Our name "Kirihat" reflects our commitment to local markets and community-driven commerce. Every order placed, every delivery made, strengthens our local economy.
